title: I Followed the Community-Theater Light Board Through Three Rehearsals After They Cut the Board Op

parts.text: They cut the night board op and posted a guest PIN on the light-booth door. I was thirty-five, electrician volunteer, holding a headset that still opened one cue. At 6:22 p.m. the PIN opened rehearsal lights and, I found, the house. Temporary, the director said. I photographed the door, both looks, the time. Then a phone I did not recognize used the same PIN toward the follow-spot. I did not argue the joke. I argued the file. I have learned the difference between a title and a line item.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: An unrecognized phone just used the guest PIN toward the follow-spot.

social.video_title: They posted the light-board PIN on the booth door — Part 1/3
social.description: Board op cut, a guest PIN, a phone toward the spot. Would you have followed the cue?

parts.text: I followed with the stills. The spot took the same four digits. The person palmed a flash that was not a rehearsal look I could see from the booth. I was still thirty-five, still volunteered, suddenly the only witness with a timestamp. I messaged safety the door still and stayed in the camera cone. The person looked at the cone, then at the last panel on the hazer. I added the second still before anyone could call it a vibe. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: They are at the hazer panel; safety now has the still.

social.video_title: The same four digits opened the follow-spot — Part 2/3
social.description: A flash off-look, a camera cone, hazer next. Safety has the still. Do you stay in the cone?

parts.text: Safety locked the hazer from the booth. The person left the flash and the PIN on a sticky. Morning recoded all three looks. The director who called it temporary lost the PIN privilege. I keep a headset that opens one cue. Doors print cues now, not keys. The booth at 6:22 sounds like a booth, which is to say fans and nobody's four digits. I go back to being a person with a receipt. The second photo is for the person who will say they never saw the first.

social.video_title: Morning recoded all three looks — Part 3/3
social.description: Sticky PIN, a lost privilege, doors that print cues. Was temporary ever three looks?
